import pytest

from ttlcache import TTLCache


class FakeClock:
    def __init__(self):
        self.now = 0.0

    def __call__(self):
        return self.now


@pytest.fixture
def clock():
    return FakeClock()


def make_cache(clock, maxsize=2, ttl=10):
    return TTLCache(maxsize, ttl, clock=clock)


def test_value_expires_at_ttl(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    c.set("a", 1)
    clock.now = 9.99
    assert c.get("a") == 1
    clock.now = 10
    assert c.get("a", "gone") == "gone"


def test_expired_entry_is_removed_on_get(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    c.set("a", 1)
    clock.now = 10
    c.get("a")
    assert "a" not in c._data


def test_set_existing_key_replaces_value_and_resets_expiry(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    c.set("a", 1)
    clock.now = 8
    c.set("a", 2)
    clock.now = 15
    assert c.get("a") == 2


def test_get_refreshes_recency(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock, maxsize=2)
    c.set("a", 1)
    c.set("b", 2)
    c.get("a")
    c.set("c", 3)
    assert "a" in c
    assert "b" not in c


def test_set_existing_key_refreshes_recency(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock, maxsize=2)
    c.set("a", 1)
    c.set("b", 2)
    c.set("a", 10)
    c.set("c", 3)
    assert "a" in c
    assert "b" not in c


def test_get_missing_returns_default(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    assert c.get("nope") is None
    assert c.get("nope", 42) == 42


def test_delete_removes_key(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    c.set("a", 1)
    c.delete("a")
    assert "a" not in c


def test_delete_missing_raises_key_error(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        c.delete("a")


def test_delete_expired_raises_key_error(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    c.set("a", 1)
    clock.now = 10
    with pytest.raises(KeyError):
        c.delete("a")


def test_contains_ignores_expired(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock)
    c.set("a", 1)
    assert "a" in c
    clock.now = 10
    assert "a" not in c


def test_len_counts_only_live_

entries(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock, maxsize=5)
    c.set("a", 1)
    clock.now = 5
    c.set("b", 2)
    assert len(c) == 2
    clock.now = 10
    assert len(c) == 1


def test_full_cache_drops_expired_before_evicting_lru(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock, maxsize=2)
    c.set("a", 1)
    clock.now = 5
    c.set("b", 2)
    clock.now = 10
    c.set("c", 3)
    assert "a" not in c
    assert c.get("b") == 2
    assert c.get("c") == 3


def test_full_cache_evicts_lru_when_nothing_expired(clock):
    c = make_cache(clock, maxsize=3)
    c.set("a", 1)
    c.set("b", 2)
    c.set("c", 3)
    c.get("a")
    c.set("d", 4)
    assert "b" not in c
    assert len(c) == 3

    c = make_cache(clock, maxsize=2)
    c.set("a", 1)
    clock.now = 5
    c.set("b", 2)
    clock.now = 10
    c.set("c", 3)
    assert len(c) == 2
    assert c.get("b") == 2

def test_non_positive_arguments_raise_value_error(maxsize, ttl):

        TTLCache(maxsize, ttl)
